story_zh: 早上，小明起来后，先刷牙、洗澡，让自己干净舒服。然后，他决定打扫房间。他把脏衣服放进包里，准备洗。接着，他检查冰箱，如果食物不新鲜，就把它搬出去。他经常帮忙做家务，认为这很简单容易。结束打扫后，他记得关灯离开房间。
story_pinyin: Zǎoshang, Xiǎo Míng qǐlái hòu, xiān shuāyá, xǐzǎo, ràng zìjǐ gānjìng shūfu. Ránhòu, tā juédìng dǎsǎo fángjiān. Tā bǎ zāng yīfu fàng jìn bāo lǐ, zhǔnbèi xǐ. Jiēzhe, tā jiǎnchá bīngxiāng, rúguǒ shíwù bù xīnxiān, jiù bǎ tā bān chūqù. Tā jīngcháng bāngmáng zuò jiāwù, rènwéi zhè hěn jiǎndān róngyì. Jiéshù dǎsǎo hòu, tā jìde guān dēng líkāi fángjiān.
story_en: In the morning, after Xiao Ming gets up, he first brushes his teeth and takes a shower to make himself clean and comfortable. Then, he decides to clean the room. He puts the dirty clothes into a bag, ready to wash them. Next, he checks the refrigerator; if the food is not fresh, he moves it out. He often helps with household chores, thinking it's simple and easy. After finishing cleaning, he remembers to turn off the light and leave the room.
